Aisha_CustSuccess: Hey team — kicking off Maple Corp onboarding thread. Hi @Priya_Maple — glad to have you. Quick intros: I’m Aisha (CS lead), Tom is your AE, Devon is your solutions eng. OnboardBot: kickoff meeting scheduled for 2026-07-12 16:00 PDT (Zoom link in calendar).
Priya_Maple: Thanks Aisha — priority is a pilot for our sales enablement flow. Goal: 5 reps using summaries + search by Aug 1. We need data residency in EU, and CRM sync.
Tom_AE: Confirmed pilot scope with Priya this morning. Finance OK with trial budget. Main ask: can we get EU data path and private deployment trial?
Devon_SE: EU private deployment is doable. Need network details and certs. Action items: get sample CRM export (CSV), list of 3 canonical prompts, and a test user set (5 reps).
Aisha_CustSuccess: Adding success criteria here so everyone’s aligned: 1) 5 reps actively using for 30 days, 2) average satisfaction >= 4/5 in feedback survey, 3) 95th pct latency < 350ms for summary endpoint, 4) no PII exfiltration incidents.
Priya_Maple: Agree. On the satisfaction metric — we'll run a quick pulse survey after week 2.
Devon_SE: Technical checklist (quick):
```
- Provision EU private cluster (Redwood Private)
- Exchange certs + open VPN (Maple infra)
- Ingest CRM snapshots, map fields
- Deploy summarization model variant (quantized)
- Enable prefix caching for sales prompts
- Setup metrics dashboard + alerting
```
Aisha_CustSuccess: 30/60/90 timeline draft: 
```
30d: cluster provisioned, CRM ingest, 5 reps onboarded, pulse survey (week 2)
60d: iterate prompts, reduce latency 10-20%, embed search pilot live
90d: expand to 25 reps, SLA review, renewal conversation prep
```
Tom_AE: Flagging renewal risk: if we miss 30d adoption target, expect push on budget and slower renewal talks. We should tie early success to sales outcomes (time saved per rep).
Priya_Maple: Understood. Can we add a simple metric: weekly saved time (self-reported) by reps? Even a rough number helps.
Devon_SE: Yes — we'll add a lightweight usage event to collect "session_duration" and a 1-question post-session rating. No PII in payload.
Aisha_CustSuccess: Owners: Aisha = project manager & success ops; Devon = technical lead; Tom = commercial owner; Priya = customer sponsor.
Priya_Maple: Who captures feedback? We prefer a short embedded form in the app.
Devon_SE: We can surface a quick 1-click feedback widget that pings a webhook to your internal tracker and our CS dashboard.
Aisha_CustSuccess: Risk register (short):
- Infra delay (owner: Devon) -> impact: pilot slip
- Data residency cert delay (owner: Priya infra) -> impact: blocked EU deployment
- Low rep engagement (owner: Aisha/Tom) -> impact: renewal risk
We’ll escalate to execs if any high-impact item isn’t cleared within 7 days.
Tom_AE: Next meeting: weekly standup Thurs 10:30 PT — first one 2026-07-15. Please add calendar invites.
OnboardBot: Standup created: Recurring weekly Thursdays 10:30 PT starting 2026-07-15.
Aisha_CustSuccess: OK everyone — immediate next steps: Priya to share sample CRM export + cert contact by EOD Tue; Devon to share EU cluster provisioning ETA by Wed; Tom to send meeting invite to sales reps; I’ll draft the week-2 pulse survey.
Priya_Maple: Will share exports and infra contacts today. Thanks all.
Devon_SE: ETA for cluster provisioning: 4 business days after we get certs.
Aisha_CustSuccess: Great — I’ll track these in our onboarding board and post updates here. If anything else pops up, ping me or drop in this thread. :thumbsup:
